description: Compare what human browsers see vs what AI crawlers see. Fetches a page four times in parallel — as Chrome, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot — and reports word-overlap %, title/description differences, and warnings about JS-only shells, cloaking, or edge-based bot blocking.
